preExistingHomographsNote: 0 introduced by this patch; native per-language duplicate metric = 0 on both base and patched. The 7 are pre-existing cross-language homographs flagged for a future ambiguity-policy/cleanup pass.

requiredStatement: This patch improves recipe resolver coverage by adding aliases and ambiguous-term handling only. It does not create new ingredient IDs and does not change nutrition. This is not a Final Verified Nutrition Dataset. Medical and strict-diet use remain out of scope.
